note: Stripe writes ISK (and UGX) as two-decimal values whose decimals are always 00 (https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#special-cases): amount_received 1250000 is 12,500 kr. Reports use ISO 4217 minor units (ISK has none), so the payment is 12500 and a 2,500 kr refund is 2500, never a hundred times more. Payloads shaped per https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object and https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds/object.
